per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must be unique across the dataset
S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N (one-to-one relationship)
Account_No must not be null
Account_No must be a 4-digit code
Account_No should not be duplicated (flag for business review)
Name must not be null
Name must use Title Case (flag all-caps or all-lowercase words except cultural particles)
Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o for Male, Binte/d/o for Female)
ID_No must not be null
ID_No must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one letter
ID_No must not be a test or placeholder value
ID_No must be unique across the dataset
ID_No prefix must be consistent with Age (S prefix implies Age >= 24, T prefix implies Age <= 24 as of 2024)
Race must not be null
Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Malay, Indian
Gender must not be null
Gender must be exactly 'Male' or 'Female' (Title Case)
Age must be parseable as an integer
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
Age must be at least 13 for a consumer service account
Contact_No must not be null
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (8 digits, starting with 6, 8, or 9, with optional +65 prefix)
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol and no whitespace characters
Country must not be null
Country must be exactly 'Singapore' (canonical form)
Street_Name must not be null
Street_Name must not contain all-uppercase words
Postal_Code must not be null
Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits when represented as a string
Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (case-insensitive)
ID_No must exactly match ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Account_No must match Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
